name: Kalpa Commercial Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1985, Kapla Commercial

keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KCL is engaged in garment and textile trading. It is involved in activities such as sourcing, manufacturing, exporting, and distributing clothing and textiles, including fabrics, ready-made garments, and related fashion accessories.

Company has high debtors of 533 days.
